    Class SaveFileData

    New clean save file data structure with dynamic runtime object storage. Uses unified SerializedRuntimeObject collection that can store any type of RuntimeObjectSaveData. Automatically extensible - no code changes needed for new saveable types! Maintains compatibility with PlayerData and GameSessionData as requested.
